mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_document_version (id, document_id, version_no, version_type, source_object_id, editor_id, content_hash, version_status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{version.id}), HEXTORAW(#{version.documentId}), #{version.versionNo}, #{version.versionType}, HEXTORAW(#{version.sourceObjectId}), HEXTORAW(#{version.editorId}), #{version.contentHash}, #{version.versionStatus})

INSERT INTO edudoc_document_version (id, document_id, version_no, version_type, source_object_id, editor_id, change_summary, content_hash, version_status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{idHex}), HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}), #{versionNo}, 'RESTORE', HEXTORAW(#{sourceObjectIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{editorIdHex}), #{changeSummary}, #{contentHash}, 'A')
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(v.document_id) AS documentId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.version_type AS versionType, RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId, RAWTOHEX(v.editor_id) AS editorId, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.version_status AS versionStatus FROM edudoc_document_version v WHERE v.source_object_id = HEXTORAW(#{sourceObjectIdHex})
SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM edudoc_document_version WHERE document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex})

SELECT RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS versionId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.version_type AS versionType, TO_CHAR(v.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createTime, v.change_summary AS changeSummary, RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId FROM edudoc_document_version v WHERE v.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) ORDER BY v.version_no DESC

SELECT RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(v.document_id) AS documentId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.version_type AS versionType, RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId, RAWTOHEX(v.editor_id) AS editorId, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.version_status AS versionStatus FROM edudoc_document_version v WHERE v.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) AND v.version_no = #{versionNo}

SELECT RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(v.document_id) AS documentId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.version_type AS versionType, RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId, RAWTOHEX(v.editor_id) AS editorId, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.version_status AS versionStatus, v.structure_json AS structureJson FROM edudoc_document_version v WHERE v.id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex})

SELECT RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) FROM edudoc_document_version v JOIN edudoc_oss_object o ON o.id = v.source_object_id WHERE v.document_id = (SELECT cur.document_id FROM edudoc_document_version cur WHERE cur.id = HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex})) AND v.version_no <= (SELECT cur.version_no FROM edudoc_document_version cur WHERE cur.id = HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex})) AND o.mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' ORDER BY v.version_no DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_document_version SET structure_json = #{json} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex})
